summary: 继兄业据江东，赤壁破曹、袭取荆州、夷陵败备，黄龙元年称帝建业，为吴国开基之主；晚年二宫之争，立嗣两误。
summary_en: He took up his brother's enterprise in Jiangdong, broke Cao at the Red Cliffs, seized Jingzhou, defeated Bei at Yiling, and in the 1st year of Huanglong took the throne at Jianye as founder of Wu; in old age the two-palace feud wrecked the succession.

portrait.appearance_basis: 三国志载「方颐大口，目有精光」。画像宜表现任才尚计的雄主之态，衣冠从孙吴初制。属艺术想象。

timeline.title: 生
timeline.summary: 孙坚次子，母吴氏；兄策统事江东时已随军。
timeline.summary_en: Second son of Sun Jian by Lady Wu; he followed the armies in his elder brother Ce's conquest of Jiangdong.

timeline.title: 统事
timeline.summary: 孙策遇刺卒，权继统江东，张昭、周瑜辅之。
timeline.summary_en: Sun Ce died by an assassin's knife; Quan took command of Jiangdong with Zhang Zhao and Zhou Yu to support him.

timeline.title: 赤壁破曹
timeline.title_en: Breaking Cao at the Red Cliffs
timeline.summary: 联合刘备，周瑜火攻，大破曹军于赤壁，天下三分之势遂定。
timeline.summary_en: Allied with Liu Bei, Zhou Yu's fire attack broke the Cao army at the Red Cliffs, fixing the tripartite division of the realm.

timeline.title: 袭取荆州
timeline.summary: 吕蒙白衣渡江袭江陵，关羽败亡，吴据有荆州。
timeline.summary_en: Lü Meng's covert crossing took Jiangling, Guan Yu fell, and Wu held Jingzhou.

timeline.title: 夷陵破备
timeline.summary: 陆逊于夷陵火攻大破刘备，吴转守为攻。
timeline.summary_en: Lu Xun's fire attack at Yiling shattered Liu Bei, turning Wu from defense to offense.

timeline.title: 称帝建业
timeline.summary: 孙权于武昌即皇帝位，旋还都建业，国号吴。
timeline.summary_en: Sun Quan took the imperial throne at Wuchang and at once moved the capital back to Jianye, styling the realm Wu.

timeline.title: 辽东通使
timeline.summary: 遣使泛海通辽东公孙渊，欲结外援；渊后杀使背约。
timeline.summary_en: He sent envoys by sea to Gongsun Yuan of Liaodong seeking an ally; Yuan later slew the envoys and broke the pact.

timeline.title: 合肥新城
timeline.summary: 亲率大军攻合肥新城，久攻不下，闻魏援至而还。
timeline.summary_en: He led the host in person against the new city of Hefei, could not take it after long siege, and withdrew on word of Wei relief.

timeline.title: 太子登卒
timeline.title_en: Death of the Crown Prince Deng
timeline.summary: 皇太子孙登病卒，立嗣问题自此始。
timeline.summary_en: Crown Prince Sun Deng died of illness, and the succession question began.

timeline.title: 废太子和
timeline.summary: 二宫之争，权废太子和，赐鲁王霸死，陆逊忧愤卒。
timeline.summary_en: In the two-palace feud Quan deposed the crown prince He, ordered Prince Ba of Lu to die, and Lu Xun died of grief and rage.

timeline.title: 权崩
timeline.summary: 立少子孙亮为太子，寻崩，年七十一；亮即位，诸葛恪辅政。
timeline.summary_en: He named his youngest son, Sun Liang, heir and died, aged seventy-one; Liang took the throne with Zhuge Ke as regent.

timeline.title: 吴主总评
timeline.summary: 陈寿评其任才尚计、有勾践之奇英，而性多嫌忌、果于杀戮，立嗣再误，吴之亡萌于斯。
timeline.summary_en: Chen Shou praised his use of talent and his stratagems — the rare heroism of a Goujian — while noting his jealousy and readiness to kill; the succession erred twice, and Wu's ruin sprouted here.

relations.note_en: Died in the second year of Taiyuan; his youngest son Liang took the throne

bio_md:
# 吴大帝 · 主要事迹

孙权字仲谋，孙坚次子，母吴氏。建安五年孙策遇刺卒，权年十九，继统江东，张昭、周瑜辅之——「举贤任能，各尽其心」，江东基业自此而固。建安十三年，曹操南下，权纳周瑜、鲁肃之议，联刘备于赤壁火攻破曹，三分之势遂定。建安二十四年，吕蒙白衣渡江袭荆州，关羽败亡，吴据有荆襄。黄武元年，陆逊于夷陵火攻大破刘备，吴转守为攻，疆域遂定。

黄龙元年，权于武昌即皇帝位，国号吴，旋还都建业——历曹操、曹丕、刘备三强并世，而权「任才尚计，有勾践之奇英」，始终为鼎足之一。称帝后数十年间，通使辽东公孙渊、攻合肥新城皆无果，而治国以宽，江东之民乐业，四十年无大战。

权之晚节，坏于立嗣：赤乌四年太子孙登卒，其后二宫之争起，群臣各附鲁王霸、太子和，权废和赐霸死，陆逊亦忧愤而卒——「阋墙之祸」自此始，吴之衰象已萌。太元二年，权立少子孙亮为太子，寻崩，年七十一，谥大皇帝。

陈寿评曰：「孙权屈身忍辱，任才尚计，有勾践之奇英，人之杰也。故能自擅江表，成鼎峙之业。然性多嫌忌，果于杀戮，暨臻末年，弥以滋甚。」「生子当如孙仲谋」之誉传于后世；然二宫之误，实为吴亡之远因，可叹权一世英雄，不悟齐家之道。

> 参考：点校本《三国志》卷047《吴主传》、卷054《周瑜传》、卷058《陆逊传》。

bio_parts_en.value:
Sun Quan, styled Zhongmou, was Sun Jian's second son by Lady Wu. In the 5th year of Jian'an, Sun Ce died by an assassin's knife, and Quan, at nineteen, took command of Jiangdong with Zhang Zhao and Zhou Yu at his side — "raising the worthy and employing the able, each giving his utmost," and the Jiangdong foundations were secured. In the 13th year of Jian'an, as Cao Cao came south, Quan took the counsel of Zhou Yu and Lu Su, allied with Liu Bei, and broke the Cao army by fire at the Red Cliffs — the tripartite balance was fixed. In the 24th year Lü Meng's covert crossing seized Jingzhou, Guan Yu fell, and Wu held the Jing province. In the 1st year of Huangwu Lu Xun's fire attack at Yiling shattered Liu Bei, and Wu turned from defense to offense, its borders set.

In the 1st year of Huanglong Quan took the imperial throne at Wuchang, styling the realm Wu, and at once returned the capital to Jianye. Through the great ages of Cao Cao, Cao Pi, and Liu Bei, "employing talent and valuing stratagems, with the rare heroism of a Goujian," he held one leg of the tripod. In the decades of his empire he sent envoys to Gongsun Yuan in Liaodong and besieged the new city of Hefei, both fruitless, while governing Jiangdong gently — the people prospered, and for forty years there was no great war.

His late years were wrecked by the succession: in the 4th year of Chiwu the crown prince Deng died, and the two-palace feud followed; the court split between Prince Ba of Lu and the crown prince He, Quan deposed He, ordered Ba to die, and Lu Xun himself died of grief and rage — the "strife within the walls" began, and Wu's decline was already visible. In the 2nd year of Taiyuan he named his youngest son, Sun Liang, heir, and died, aged seventy-one, posthumously styled Da.

Chen Shou's verdict: "Sun Quan, bending himself and swallowing humiliation, employing talent and valuing stratagems, had the rare heroism of a Goujian — a man of eminence. So he could hold the south of the river and complete the tripod's reign. But his nature was jealous and suspicious, quick to kill, and in his last years it grew worse." "A son should be born like Sun Zhongmou" passed into the people's praise; yet the succession's double error was the distant cause of Wu's fall — a pity that a lifetime's hero could not keep his own house.

> References: the punctuated critical edition of the *Sanguozhi*, ch. 47 ("Biography of the Wu Sovereign"), ch. 54 (biography of Zhou Yu), ch. 58 (biography of Lu Xun).
